title: Model training method and model training device

pse.problem: Inefficient communication and processing due to large amounts of data in vertical federated learning, impacting training speed and accuracy.
pse.solution_function: Random sparse processing algorithm applied during model training for vertical federated learning to improve randomness of training samples, reducing the adverse impact on model training process and improving accuracy and universality while also minimizing communication volume.
pse.solution_structure: Vertical federated learning model consisting of multiple first sub-models and a second sub-model, with interconnected output and input ends. The solution involves randomization vector, target real number, vectors of elements, and subscript-encoded data.
pse.solution_implementation: Performing random sparse processing on the first intermediate result to obtain the sample intermediate result by determining a randomization vector based on the formula r(r 1 U(0x 1 )...r N U(0X N )) and retaining elements corresponding to the subscripts of the second target number with the largest absolute value. Decompression of the sample intermediate results to obtain the sample decompression results.
pse.effect: Improved training efficiency, accuracy, and universality of the model due to reduced communication volume and improved randomness of training samples.
